description:
Publish source as an agent: a SOUL.md describing who it is, a valet.yaml declaring the skills, connectors, channels, and configuration it runs with, and any supporting files. Use it when the work is an agent that answers on a channel or runs on a schedule, not a website or an app. Apply the governance skill before calling.

Send the agent one of two ways. files carries it in the call, which works from any client. push: {id, commit} publishes a commit you pushed with git: call create_push, run the recipe it returns, then pass the push_id and the commit sha it prints. Use push when you can run git with network access or when you changed a clone of the agent's source; a push that builds on a main that has since moved is merged onto it as a deploy is. Pass files or push, not both.

The tree, in files or in the commit, must include valet.yaml and SOUL.md at the root. Unlike a website's or an app's, an agent's valet.yaml is yours: Valet validates it rather than writing it, and refuses one the agent rules reject. An organization connector or channel the manifest names is attached for you. When the manifest names one the organization does not have, or a skill that does not resolve, nothing deploys and the answer lists what is pending and the tool that sets each up; do that and call again with the same files.

Publishing changes an agent that exists: create it first with create_service (kind: agent), then publish to its name. A name that holds no agent is refused. Publishing replaces the agent's source with these files, so read get_source first when the agent is not yours. An agent deploy finishes before this call returns: the answer carries the release version, and get_service reports whether the agent is running and what it holds. In an organization with release policies, the answer may carry evaluation instead of a version: the release is built and waits for its policies, and get_evaluation with wait_seconds 20 follows it. Requires connecting a Valet account.

discard_draft.description: Set true to discard an open draft on this agent that another session left. Omit to be told about it instead. Not used with push.

files.description: Required unless push is given. The agent's files, [{path, content}], including valet.yaml and SOUL.md at the root.

content.description: Required. The file's complete text content.

path.description: Required. The file's path, relative to the agent root.

idempotency_key.description: An opaque key of your choosing. Repeating a call with the same key returns the first call's result instead of deploying a second release. Use a new key for new files: a repeated key returns the earlier result even when the files changed. A call that deployed nothing gives its key back.

name.description: Required. The agent's name. The agent must exist: create it first with create_service. Publishing to it replaces its source.

org_name.description: The Valet organization to publish into. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

push.description: Publish a Git push instead of files: the id create_push returned and the commit you pushed to its branch. Use it when you can run git with network access, because it sends only what changed. Pass files or push, not both; every other argument keeps its meaning.

commit.description: Required. The full sha of the commit you pushed to the push's branch. The recipe create_push returned prints it.

name: publish_agent
title: Publish an agent
